title: Garden tip cart
description: Small red garden tip cart on two lugged wheels: an open-top box hopper (walls leaning out a little) with a yellow lip and band, a scalable green clippings heap inside, steel mudguards, a single tongue to the hitch eye at the front with a little stand, and a tow bar with a pin at the back. Same contract as cart.glb. Material `paint` is repainted per player.
checks: LEFT tile: a box hopper on one axle of small wheels that touch the grid line, a tongue reaching forward to the front end, a tow bar at the back end
3/4 tile: the hopper is open on top and holds a green clippings mound below the yellow lip
BACK tile: wheels either side under mudguards, the tow pin in the middle at the bottom
TOP tile: the tongue runs straight down the centre line to a single hitch eye
